Class OrderedNeighborsToEdgesCSVWriter

java.lang.Object
readWrite.OrderedNeighborsToEdgesCSVWriter
public class OrderedNeighborsToEdgesCSVWriter extends Object
Writes ordered-neighbor data to a CSV edge list.

Given an n x n ordered-neighbor table, this writer exports directed weighted edges of the form:

Object-i, Object-j, -k

where k is the rank assigned by i to j. Negative weights preserve order while allowing larger-magnitude weights to represent less-similar neighbors.

  • Method Details

    • setOrderedNeighbors

      public void setOrderedNeighbors(int[][] orderedNeighbors)
      Sets the ordered-neighbor table used for CSV export.

      The expected convention is orderedNeighbors[x][k] = y, meaning object y is the k-th nearest neighbor of object x according to x's ranking.

      Parameters:
      orderedNeighbors - the ordered Neighbors from the rank Table

      orderedNeighbors[x][k] = y means y is the k-th nearest neighbor of x, according to x's ranking. See ConcordanceExplorer.

    • writeFirstKNeighborsToEdgeFile

      public void writeFirstKNeighborsToEdgeFile(int numberNeighbors, String edgeFileName)
      Writes one directed edge per object/rank pair to a CSV file.

      For each source object i, the method exports neighbor ranks k = 1..numberNeighbors. Rank 0 (self-neighbor) is skipped by convention.

      Call setOrderedNeighbors(int[][]) before invoking this method.

      Parameters:
      numberNeighbors - how many ordered neighbors of x (other than x) to take
      edgeFileName - file to contain "object, object, weight" triples.
